qualityRules: No broad dictionary pivot admitted merely to meet a count.
Bulk entry requires a shared WordNet sense, matching POS, reviewed German–Arabic gloss anchor, exact German-to-English dictionary gloss, and direct Dutch agreement from German and English.
Common function words and legacy meanings use contextually authored four-language concepts, assisted by AI and not certified human translations.
Only validated target/native fields are retained in source example records.
